estop_hold_hint: Keyboard: hold Space or Enter for 2 seconds.
estop_sheet_after: You can lift the emergency stop at any time. Afterwards, every agent has to sign in again.
estop_sheet_body: All agents are blocked immediately. Pending approvals are declined. Home Assistant itself keeps running normally.
estop_triggered_toast: Emergency stop triggered. All agents are blocked.
banner_approvers_hint: Approvals go to one person only. Add a second one in case they can’t be reached.
banner_chain_body: Entries from this point on may have been altered.
banner_chain_title: Audit chain broken at entry no. {number}
banner_estop_body: All agents have been blocked since {time}.
banner_ha_body: All requests are declined, nothing will be replayed later. Disconnected since {time}.
overview_error_body: The connection to the Home-Mandate service was interrupted. Mandates and the emergency stop keep working independently of this page.
requests_empty_body: When an agent wants to do something that needs confirmation, it shows up here.
requests_ha_down: While Home Assistant is unreachable, approvals can’t be delivered. Affected requests are declined.
requests_history_empty_body: Once someone answers an approval or it expires, the result shows up here.
requests_ui_approve_note: Approvals here count like those from a phone and are logged with your name.
request_phone_note: Approve or decline from the notification on your phone.
agent_detail_end_desc: Takes effect immediately and permanently. Pending approvals are declined.
agent_detail_rate_usage: {used} of {limit} actions in the last hour
agent_requests_today: {count, plural, one {{count, number} request today} other {{count, number} requests today}}
agent_revoked_banner: Revoked on {date} by {admin}. This agent can’t do anything anymore.
agents_add_how: How does your agent sign in?
agents_empty_body: Connect an agent with a pairing code or browser sign-in. Until you assign a mandate, it can’t do anything.
agents_error_body: Approved agents keep working within their mandates.
agents_way_browser_desc: For agents like Claude Code. You enter an address, the agent opens a consent page.
agents_way_code_desc: For agents without a browser, e.g. local language models or scripts. The agent shows a code, you type it in here.
activity_empty_body: As soon as an agent makes a request, it appears here and in the audit log.
audit_chain_broken: Audit log broken from entry no. {number}
audit_chain_broken_body: From here on, entries no longer fit the chain. They may have been altered. Older entries are unchanged.
audit_empty_body: Change the period or reset the filters.
audit_entry_broken: This entry doesn’t fit the chain. Its content may have been altered.
audit_error_body: New entries are still being written.
audit_select_hint: Select an entry to see details.
onboarding_body: Agents can’t do anything by default. You decide what they may do in your home. Your first mandate takes about 5 minutes.
onboarding_step1_body: With a pairing code or a browser sign-in.
onboarding_step2_body: Start from a template like “Read only” and adjust it.
noaccess_approver: You can still confirm approvals from the notification on your phone.
noaccess_body: Only Home Assistant administrators can manage Home-Mandate.
notfound_body: This address doesn’t exist in Home-Mandate. An agent or mandate may have been removed.
decision_ask_desc: A person must confirm on their phone.
decision_default_desc: No rule applies, so it’s denied. This is always the case and can’t be changed.
critical_desc: Affects your safety: door, gate, alarm, camera or script.
critical_override_label: Also allow critical actions without approval
critical_override_off: Off: critical actions automatically become approval requests.
critical_override_on: On: “unlock Front door” runs without approval.
demoted_hint: Becomes an approval request because the action is critical.
rule_count_matches: {count, plural, one {Matches {count, number} device} other {Matches {count, number} devices}}
rule_overridden: For “{action}”, rule {n} overrides this – the stricter decision wins.
rule_overridden_timed: For “{action}”, rule {n} overrides this at times ({window}).
rule_read_not_included: “Read” isn’t included. Write access doesn’t include read access.
toast_save_failed: Couldn’t save. Your changes are still here.
revoke_body: The agent is blocked immediately and permanently. To use it again, you have to approve it anew.
revoke_type_label: To confirm, type the agent’s name: {agent}
field_name_help: Only visible to you, e.g. “Kitchen voice assistant”.
device_picker_selected: {count, plural, one {{count, number} device selected} other {{count, number} devices selected}}
time_error_equal: Start and end of the time window are the same.
timeout_error: Timeout must be between 10 seconds and 1 hour.
timeout_help: Between 10 seconds and 1 hour. After that, the request counts as declined.
pair_code_expired: This code has expired. Ask the agent to show a new one.
pair_code_help: 8 characters, exactly as the agent shows it. Case doesn’t matter.
pair_code_locked: Too many attempts. Pairing is locked for {minutes} minutes.
pair_code_where: The agent shows the code when it starts, e.g. in its terminal or log.
pair_code_wrong: This code doesn’t match any waiting agent. Check your input.
pair_done_body: From now on the agent may do what the mandate “{mandate}” allows. Everything else stays denied.
pair_mandate_none_desc: The agent is connected but can’t do anything until you assign a mandate.
pair_verify_body: Compare the client ID with what your agent shows. The name was provided by the agent itself.
mcp_endpoint_help: Enter this address in your agent.
browser_note: Home-Mandate never shows credentials. The agent receives them directly through the sign-in.
browser_step1: Enter this address in your agent as an MCP server.
browser_step2: The agent opens a page in your browser. Sign in there with your Home Assistant account.
browser_step3: On the consent page, check the client ID, choose a mandate and approve the agent.
browser_title: Connect an agent with browser sign-in
browser_waiting: Once you’ve approved it, the agent appears in the list.
consent_domain_note: This domain is verified. The name above comes from the agent itself.
consent_done_allow_body: You can close this window and return to the agent.
consent_done_deny_body: The agent didn’t get access. You can close this window.
consent_err_meta_body: Home-Mandate couldn’t fetch the agent’s description from {url}. Without it, the agent can’t be approved.
consent_err_meta_hint: Try again in a few minutes or contact the agent’s provider.
consent_err_redirect_body: The agent wants to return to {url} but only registered {registered}. For your safety, the request was stopped.
consent_lead: Only approve the agent if you just started this connection yourself.
consent_mandate_help: You can change the mandate at any time later.
consent_nonadmin_body: Ask someone with admin rights in Home Assistant to do this step. You can close this window.
consent_redirect_note: After your decision, you’ll be sent back here.
mandates_empty_body: A mandate defines what an agent may do. Without one, everything is denied.
mandates_rules_count: {count, plural, one {{count, number} rule} other {{count, number} rules}}
mandates_templates_note: Locks, gates, alarms and cameras are never allowed in templates.
tpl_empty_desc: Everything denied. You add rules yourself.
tpl_read_only_desc: Can read the state of every device, but switch nothing.
tpl_voice_desc: Lights, switches, climate and media allowed. Locks only with approval. Cameras denied.
editor_approvers_help: They receive the push notification. At least one person.
editor_rules_help: If several rules apply, the strictest wins: denied before ask before allowed. Order is only for readability.
editor_unsaved: {count, plural, one {{count, number} unsaved change} other {{count, number} unsaved changes}}
validation_summary: {count, plural, one {{count, number} error. Please fix before saving.} other {{count, number} errors. Please fix before saving.}}
preview_device_count: {count, plural, one {{count, number} device} other {{count, number} devices}}
preview_matching: {count, plural, one {{count, number} rule applies} other {{count, number} rules apply, the strictest wins}}
save_body: Applies to {agent} immediately. This creates version {version}; the previous one stays viewable.
save_more: {count, plural, one {… and {count, number} more} other {… and {count, number} more}}
matrix_count: {count, plural, one {{count, number} device} other {{count, number} devices}}
filter_results: {count, plural, one {{count, number} entry} other {{count, number} entries}}
result_invalid_hint: A response came from someone without permission. The request was therefore denied at once, and the approvers were warned.
code_critical_demotion: Allowed, but the action is critical, so approval was requested.
code_invalid_mandate: The mandate is invalid and isn’t applied.
code_invalid_request: The request was malformed and wasn’t evaluated.
code_no_match: No rule applies, so it was denied.
code_revoked: The agent or mandate had been revoked.
code_rule: A rule of the mandate decided.
code_unknown_action: The agent requested an unknown action.
code_unknown_category: The device doesn’t belong to a known category.
set_about_desc: Home-Mandate sits between AI agents and Home Assistant.
set_approvals_desc: Applies to all mandates that don’t set their own value.
set_approver_no_device: No phone with the Home Assistant app. Can’t receive approvals.
set_approvers_desc: These people receive approval requests as push notifications. At least one person is required.
set_approvers_min: At least one person must receive approvals.
set_estop_lift_body: Previous access stays invalid. Every agent has to sign in again; agents using a pairing code need a new code. Mandates are kept.
set_estop_off_desc: Blocks all agents immediately. Home Assistant keeps running normally.
set_estop_on_desc: Active since {time}, triggered by {person}. All agents are blocked.
set_ha_mode_app: Home-Mandate runs as a Home Assistant app. The connection is managed automatically.
set_ha_test_fail_401: The token is rejected (401). Check that it was copied completely.
set_ha_test_ok: Connection works. Home Assistant {version}, user “{user}” with admin rights.
set_ha_token_help: Create it in Home Assistant under Profile → Security → Long-lived access tokens. It is only stored, never shown.
set_ha_token_stored: Saved on {date}. For security reasons it is never shown.
set_ha_why_body: Only to receive approval responses from the phone app. Home-Mandate sends nothing but a fixed list of commands, such as switching a light or unlocking a lock, and only when a mandate allows it.
set_ha_why_title: Why does Home-Mandate need admin rights?
set_retention_value: 30 days. Older entries are removed daily; that is logged too.
set_tls_missing: No certificate found. Place fullchain.pem and privkey.pem in /ssl. Without TLS, agents outside your home network can’t connect securely.
countdown_seconds_left: {count, plural, one {{count, number} second left} other {{count, number} seconds left}}
common_copy_failed: Copying was not possible. The text is selected; copy it with Ctrl+C.
banner_conn_body: This view shows the state of {time}. Reconnecting … Mandates and the emergency stop keep working.
app_error_title: Home-Mandate can’t be reached right now
estop_failed: The emergency stop could not be triggered. Please try again right away.
validation_name: Enter a name of up to {max, number} characters.
validation_limit: The rate limit must be between {min, number} and {max, number}.
validation_expires_order: “Valid until” must not be before “Valid from”.
validation_window_incomplete: Enter the start and end of the time window.
validation_rule: This rule is invalid and can’t be saved like this.
validation_too_many_rules: A mandate can have at most {max, number} rules.
rule_moved: Rule {from} is now at position {to} of {count}.
rule_readonly_extension: This rule uses an extension category. It can’t be edited here, only moved or deleted.
critical_override_reset: The permission without approval was withdrawn because the rule changed.
mandates_new_body: The mandate starts as a copy of the template and applies immediately. You can adjust it afterwards.
mandates_new_none: Every active agent already has a mandate. A new agent gets one when it is paired.
mandates_new_failed: Couldn’t create the mandate. Please try again.
mandates_new_conflict: This agent has a mandate by now.
editor_not_found_body: It may have been removed. The list shows all mandates.
editor_revoked_note: This mandate is revoked and no longer applies. You can view it but not change it.
editor_conflict_title: This mandate was changed in the meantime
editor_conflict_body: Version {version} was saved in the meantime. Your changes are still here but refer to the older version.
editor_agent_help: A mandate always belongs to its agent.
editor_valid_until_help: That day is still included. Empty means no end date.
save_order_changed: Order of the rules changed (no effect)
save_rejected: The server rejected the mandate. Please check the entries.
matrix_select_hint: Select a cell to see which rule decides.
matrix_invalid: The draft has errors. While they exist none of it would apply, so the preview shows the default everywhere.
matrix_no_devices: Home Assistant reported no devices. The rules still apply as soon as devices exist.
versions_pick: Choose a version to compare with the current one
versions_single: There is only this one version. Once you change the mandate, earlier ones appear here.
restore_body: Applies to {agent} immediately. This creates version {next} with the content of version {version}; nothing is overwritten.
save_effect_unknown: Home Assistant delivered no device list. The effect can’t be computed right now; the rules apply anyway.
matrix_no_catalog: Couldn’t load the device list. The preview is therefore empty; the rules apply anyway.
save_validity_longer: The mandate applies for longer than before: earlier start or later end.
matrix_not_in_effect: This mandate doesn’t apply right now ({status}). The preview shows what applies while it is valid.
